{1c:19}{0b:08}【 Dias 】{0b:09}
What our eyes perceive is wholly
different,{1a}yet the labyrinth's structure and the
placement of the monsters do not
change at all... A baffling labyrinth.{1a}Does this, too, have some connection to
the fusion of the spirit world and the
material world, and the 'New World'
drawing near...?{07:0a}{1a}The 'New World'...{07:0f} Who in the world
contrived this...{07:05}{1a}...{07:14}We return to town. We go to Qumran.{07:05}{0c:020701}
